args.sql:
SELECT 
    LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(l.regioncode, E'\t', ' '))) as area_code,
    AVG(CAST(p.dwelling_specs->>'Bath_Count' AS numeric) / h.residentcount) as avg_bathroom_ratio
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
JOIN locations l ON h.loczone = l.zonenum
GROUP BY area_code
ORDER BY area_code;

SELECT 
    LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.regioncode, E'\t', ' '), '  ', ' '))) as area_code,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(p.dwelling_specs->>'Bath_Count' AS numeric) / h.residentcount), 2) as avg_bathroom_ratio
FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
JOIN locations l ON h.loczone = l.zonenum
GROUP BY area_code
ORDER BY area_code;
